1. (Currently amended) A method of treating Argininosuccinate Synthetase Deficiency (ASD) in a human subject, the method comprising administering to the subject in need of treatment a composition comprising an mRNA encoding argininosuccinate synthetase (ASS1) encapsulated within a liposome comprising a cationic lipid, a non-cationic lipid, cholesterol, and a PEG-modified lipid in a molar ratio of approximately 40:30:20:10, at an effective dose ranging from about 0.1 to 5.0 mg/kg body weight and an administration interval of once a week by intravenous administration, such that at least one symptom or feature of the ASD is reduced in intensity, severity, or frequency or has its onset delayed.

2. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the mRNA is encapsulated within the liposome.

3. (Currently amended) The method of claim 2, wherein the liposome comprises the one or more cationic lipids, the one or more non-cationic lipids, the cholesterol-based lipids and the one or more PEG-modified lipids.

4. (Originally presented) The method of claim 3, wherein the one or more cationic lipids comprise a cationic lipid selected from the group consisting of C12-200, MC3, DLinDMA, DLinkC2DMA, cKK-E12, ICE (Imidazol-based), HGT5000, HGT5001, DODAC, DDAB, DMRIE, DOSPA, DOGS, DODAP, DODMA and DMDMA, DODAC, DLenDMA, DMRIE, CLinDMA, CpLinDMA, DMOBA, DOcarbDAP, DLinDAP, DLincarbDAP, DLinCDAP, KLin-K-DMA, DLin-K-XTC2-DMA, HGT4003, and combination thereof.

5. (Originally presented) The method of claim 4, wherein the one or more cationic lipids comprise cKK-E12.

6. (Originally presented) The method of claim 3, wherein the one or more cholesterol-based lipids are cholesterol and/or PEGylated cholesterol.

7. (Cancelled)

8. (Cancelled)

9. (Originally presented) The method of claim 2, wherein the liposome comprises a combination selected from: cKK-E12, DOPE, cholesterol and DMG-PEG2K; C12-200, DOPE, cholesterol and DMG-PEG2K; HGT4003, DOPE, cholesterol and DMG-PEG2K; or ICE, DOPE, cholesterol and DMG-PEG2K.

10. (Originally presented) The method of claim 2, wherein the liposome has a size less than about 100 nm.
